selectionRule: Keep all 56 members of the existing outcome-blind annotation inventory; no selection by reward. Admission is pending documented task QC and exposure/grouping review; independent human annotation is not claimed.
scope: retrospective single-ecosystem open-book utility under bounded resources

conditions.C: adapted same-source reference cards plus shared factual supplement
conditions.D: document-only adapted migration procedure plus identical reference cards and factual supplement

repetitionStatus: proposed; confirm affordability on development tasks before registration
mainRunsFormula: 8*N*R; proposed R=3 gives 24*N, including every condition and model
materialDelivery: same ENTRY.md discovery and read-only /app/materials mount; disable native skills and auto-discovery in all arms
sharedTools: no skill-provided executable helpers in any arm; same preinstalled local tools per task across conditions
